info.title: Work Analytics
info.description:
The Work Analytics API provides metrics related to call queues activity as well as agent activity on queues.
### **Time filtering**
If no time filtering is provided, the returned metrics reflect the agent activity in the last 24 hours. \
The reports can be generated for a specific date range, specified using 'startDate' and 'endDate' parameters, in ISO 8601 format. If a specific intra day time range is desired, the 'intraDayStart' and 'intraDayEnd', in ISO 8601 format, must be used.
### **Examples:**

  - To obtain a full day report from 1st of May to 5th of May, in UTC, use startDate: 2023-05-01T00:00:00Z and endDate: 2023-05-05T00:00:00Z. 
  - To obtain a report from 1st of May to 5th of May, in a specific time zone, starting from 8 AM to 6 PM, use startDate: 2023-05-01T00:00:00-0700 and endDate: 2023-05-05T00:00:00-07000, intraDayStart: 08:00:00-0700, intraDayEnd: 18:00:00-0700.

get.summary: Get Agent Activity Metrics per Queues
get.description: This endpoint returns the agent activity metrics for the selected pbx, grouped by queue and agent. The response can be further filtered by a list of queues, sites, agents, user or queue statuses. If no date range is provided, the metrics reflect the agent activity in the last 24 hours.

parameters.name: pbxId
parameters.description: Id of the PBX.

parameters.name: siteIds
parameters.description: Site ids filtering. Multiple values can be passed separated by comma. If not passed, all sites data for the given pbx will be returned.

parameters.name: queueIds
parameters.description: Call Queue ids filtering. Multiple values can be passed separated by comma. If not passed, all queues data for the given pbx will be returned.

parameters.name: userIds
parameters.description: User ids filtering. Multiple values can be passed separated by comma.

parameters.name: userStatuses
parameters.description: User statuses filtering. Multiple values can be passed separated by comma.

parameters.name: queueStatuses
parameters.description: Queue statuses filtering. Multiple values can be passed separated by comma.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Report start date in ISO 8601 standard. If startDate is entered, endDate is required as well.

Start date in U.S. Pacific Time time zon.description: 2023-06-14 start date in U.S. Pacific Time time zone

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Report end date in ISO 8601 standard. If endDate is entered, startDate is required as well.

End date in U.S. Pacific Time time zone.description: 2023-06-15 end date in U.S. Pacific Time time zone

parameters.name: intraDayStart
parameters.description: Report intra day start time (up to seconds) in ISO 8601 standard. If intraDayStart is entered, intraDayEnd is required as well. Report intraDayStart/intraDayEnd parameters should be passed only when report startDate/endDate are passed as well.

intra day start time in U.S. Pacific Tim.description: 8 AM in U.S. Pacific Time time zone

parameters.name: intraDayEnd
parameters.description: Report intra day end time (up to seconds) in ISO 8601 standard. If intraDayEnd is entered, intraDayStart is required as well. Report intraDayStart/intraDayEnd parameters should be passed only when report startDate/endDate are passed as well.

intra day end time in U.S. Pacific Time.description: 6 PM in U.S. Pacific Time time zone

parameters.name: metrics
parameters.description:
Expected metrics in response. Multiple values can be passed separated by comma. Time and duration metrics are returned in **seconds**.
**Values allowed and their description**
| Name                                  | Description                                                                                                                                     |
|---------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| missedInteractions                    | The number of interactions that were missed by the user.                                                                                        |
| rejectedInteractions                  | The number of interactions that were rejected by the user.                                                                                      |
| ongoingTalkingInteractions            | The number of interactions that are currently in the talking phase.                                                                             |
| rejectedInteractionsPercentage        | The percentage of interactions that were rejected by the user.                                                                                  |
| averageOnHoldInteractionsTime         | The average time that interactions were on hold.                                                                                                |
| ongoingOnHoldInteractions             | The number of interactions that are currently on hold.                                                                                          |
| userStatusTime                        | The total time the user has been in their current status.                                                                                       |
| missedInteractionsPercentage          | The percentage of interactions that were missed by the user.                                                                                    |
| ongoingWrapUpInteractionsTime         | The time spent on interactions that are currently in the wrap-up phase.                                                                         |
| ongoingAvgTalkingInteractionsTime     | The average time spent on interactions that are currently in the talking phase.                                                                 |
| enteredInteractions                   | The number of interactions that the user has entered into.                                                                                      |
| ongoingTotalHandlingInteractionsTime  | The total time spent on interactions that are currently being handled.                                                                          |
| acceptedInteractionsPercentage        | The percentage of interactions that were accepted by the user.                                                                                  |
| averageTalkingInteractionsTime        | The average time spent on interactions during the talking phase.                                                                                |
| agentTotalTalkTime                    | Cumulative duration of the talk time of all answered calls by this agent during the time period monitored                                       |
| agentAverageTimeToAnswer              | The average time the agent takes to answer interactions in the queue after alerting begins (alerting duration). Returns null when the agent answered no interactions in the selected period. |
| totalInteractionTime                  | The total time spent on all interactions.                                                                                                       |
| ongoingHandlingInteractions           | The number of interactions that are currently being handled by the user.                                                                        |
| queueStatusTime                       | The total time the user has been in the queue status.                                                                                           |
| ongoingWrapUpInteractions             | The number of interactions that are currently in the wrap-up phase.                                                                             |
| ongoingAvgHandlingInteractionsTime    | The average time spent on interactions that are currently being handled.                                                                        |
| ongoingOnHoldInteractionsTime         | The time spent on interactions that are currently on hold.                                                                                      |
| ongoingTalkingInteractionsTime        | The time spent on interactions that are currently in the talking phase.                                                                         |
| averageWrapUpTime                     | The average time spent on interactions during the wrap-up phase.                                                                                |
| acceptedInteractions                  | The number of interactions that were accepted by the user.                                                                                      |

parameters.description:
Expected metrics in response. Multiple values can be passed separated by comma. Time and duration metrics are returned in **seconds**. **Values allowed and their description** | Metric | Description | | ---------------- | ------------| | abandonedInWaitingCalls | The total number of waiting interactions that ended up as being hung up by the customer | | abandonedInWaitingCallsPercentage | The total number of waiting calls that ended up as being hung up by the customer over the number of entered calls | | abandonedInHandlingCalls | The total number of calls abandoned by the caller while being handled by an agent | | abandonedInHandlingCallsPercentage | The number of calls abandoned during handling over the number of entered calls | | acceptedCalls | The total number of interactions answered by agents in the queue | | acceptedCallsPercentage | The total number of calls answered over the number of entered calls | | activeCalls | The number of calls still active at the end of the selected interval | | averageHandlingTime | Average handling time for interactions in the specified time frame | | averageOnHoldTime | Average on hold time for finished calls | | averageTalkTime | Average talk time in the specified time frame | | averageTimeToAnswer | The average time agents take to answer calls (alerting duration) | | averageWaitingTime | Average waiting time for interactions in the specified time frame | | completedCalls | The number of calls completed at the end of the selected interval | | divertedCalls | The total number of unique inbound calls that entered the queue and were routed to another destination by the system — such as voicemail, another queue, a ring group, or an external number — without ever being offered to any agent. The call never rang at any agent's device.

This metric helps distinguish between calls lost due to agent behavior (Missed, Rejected) and calls the system routed away before any agent was involved, which typically indicates a capacity, staffing, or routing configuration issue.

This metric is calculated after calls are completed, so ongoing calls are not included until they end. | | divertedCallsPercentage | The percentage of queue entries that were diverted by the system without ever being offered to an agent. Calculated as: (Diverted ÷ Queue Entries) × 100. ongoingEnabledOverflowAgents | Number of enabled overflow agents | | ongoingEnabledPrimaryAgents | Number of enabled primary agents | | ongoingHandlingCalls | Handling calls | | ongoingLoggedOutAndDndAgents | Number of primary and secondary users in statuses: Offline, Logged out, Dnd | | ongoingLoggedOutAndDndOverflowAgents | Number of secondary users in statuses: Offline, ongoingLongestWaitingTime | Longest waiting time | | ongoingOnHoldCalls | On hold calls | | ongoingOnHoldTime | On hold time | | ongoingOverflowAgents | Total number of secondary users assigned to the queue regardless of their available status | | ongoingOverflowWrappingUpAgents | The number of secondary users in Wrap-up state | | ongoingPrimaryWrappingUpAgents | The number of primary users in Wrap-up state | | ongoingTalkingCalls | Talking calls | | ongoingTalkingTime | Talking time | | ongoingTotalCalls | Total calls | | ongoingTotalHandlingTime | Total handling time | | ongoingWaitingCalls | Waiting calls | | ongoingWaitingTime | Waiting time | | ongoingWrappingUpAgents | The number of primary and secondary users in Wrap-up state | | totalHandlingTime | Total handling time for interactions in the specified time frame | | totalOnHoldTime | Total on hold time for interactions in the specified time frame | | totalTalkTime | Total talk time for calls in the call queue | | transferredToCallQueuePercentage | The total number of calls that were transferred to a call queue over the number of entered calls | | transferredToExternalNumber | The total number of interactions that were transferred to an external number | | transferredToRingGroup | The total number of interactions that were transferred to a ring group | | transferredToRingGroupPercentage | The get.description: Returns the calls that are currently active (in progress) for the given PBX at the moment of the query. This is a real-time snapshot, so no date-range filtering applies. The same endpoint is also served under `/analytics/work/v2/pbxes/{pbxId}/calls/active`.

parameters.name: pbxId
parameters.description: Id of the PBX.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
Response fields to return. Multiple values can be passed separated by comma. If not passed, all available fields are returned.   
**Values allowed and their description**
| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| callId | Unique identifier of the call |
| startTime | Time the call started, in epoch milliseconds |
| connectedTime | Time the call was answered/connected, in epoch milliseconds |
| callerId | Identifier of the calling party |
| callerAddress | Address or extension number of the caller |
| callerName | Name of the caller |
| callerDeviceId | Unique identifier of the device used by the caller |
| callerDeviceModel | Model of the device used by the caller |
| latestCalleeAddress | Address or extension number of the most recent callee |
| latestCalleeName | Name of the most recent callee |
| latestCalleeDeviceId | Unique identifier of the device used by the most recent callee |
| latestCalleeDeviceModel | Model of the device used by the most recent callee |
| direction | Direction of the call (INTERNAL, INBOUND or OUTBOUND) |
| reference | Reference number associated with the call |
| sip | SIP identifier of the call |
| latestLabel | Most recent state label the call is currently in |
| labels | Ordered list of states the call has passed through |
| outcome | Current outcome classification of the call |
| talkingDuration | Cumulative talk time on the call so far |
| onHoldDuration | Cumulative on-hold time on the call so far |
| waitingDuration | Cumulative waiting time on the call so far |
| totalDuration | Total elapsed duration of the call so far |

messages: user [user_name] does not have access to pbxId [PBX_ID] to make this request.

get.description: Returns unreturned calls for the given PBX, aggregated per caller — calls into the PBX that were not answered and have not been called back. Each row groups a caller with the callee they last tried to reach, the number of unreturned attempts and the most recent attempt time. The same endpoint is also served under `/analytics/work/v2/pbxes/{pbxId}/calls/unreturned`.

parameters.name: pbxId
parameters.description: Id of the PBX.

parameters.name: callerAddresses
parameters.description: Restrict to specific caller addresses (comma-separated).

parameters.name: calleeAddresses
parameters.description: Restrict to specific callee addresses (comma-separated).

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
Response fields to return. Multiple values can be passed separated by comma. If not passed, all available fields are returned.   
**Values allowed and their description**
| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| callerId | Identifier of the calling party |
| callerAddress | Address or extension number of the caller |
| callerName | Name of the caller |
| callerDeviceId | Unique identifier of the device used by the caller |
| callerDeviceModel | Model of the device used by the caller |
| callerServiceName | Name of the service used by the caller |
| callerServiceType | Type of the service used by the caller |
| calleeAddress | Address or extension number of the callee that was not returned to |
| calleeName | Name of the callee |
| calleeDeviceId | Unique identifier of the device used by the callee |
| calleeDeviceModel | Model of the device used by the callee |
| calleeServiceName | Name of the service used by the callee |
| calleeServiceType | Type of the service used by the callee |
| siteId | Identifier of the site the callee belongs to |
| siteName | Name of the site the callee belongs to |
| attempts | Number of unreturned call attempts made by the caller |
| latestStartTime | Start time of the most recent unreturned call, in epoch milliseconds |
